sections.body: An SSW No. 1 worker performs assigned construction tasks under the designated direction. The official fields are 土木 (civil engineering), 建築 (building construction), and ライフライン・設備 (utilities and facilities). An assignment does not automatically include every task on a site.
sections.title: Concepts and Scope

sections.body:
Before starting, confirm the trade, location, drawing, sequence, and person giving instructions. No. 1 workers should ask for clarification when task boundaries, conditions, or competence requirements are unclear; a worker's status does not imply authority to supervise others.

Practice scenario: You are asked to move from the civil works team to a utility task without an explanation of the drawings.
Response: Pause the unclear part and confirm the scope and instructions with the supervisor.

sections.body: Before work begins, the team reviews the method, sequence, expected hazards, person in charge, and any changed conditions. The plan must match project documents and the briefing. Clear, concise communication helps workers understand the limits and what to do if a hazard occurs.

Response: Stop the affected activity, inform the supervisor, and coordinate a new route and access restrictions.

sections.body: Field measurements transfer coordinates, reference lines, dimensions, and elevations from documents to the site. Use the reference point and measuring instrument specified in the instructions; make sure the instrument is stable and checked. Re-measuring can reveal errors before the work is covered.
sections.title: Concepts and Scope

sections.body:
Identify the designated stake or benchmark, check the instrument, measure at the specified point and in the required units, then compare the result with project tolerances. Mark the point clearly and record changes or discrepancies. Request an inspection if the result is uncertain.

Practice scenario: The elevation mark on site differs from your coworker's measurement.
Response: Do not choose a value by guesswork; verify the reference point and repeat the check with an authorized person.

sections.body:
Inspect the designated points before the next task makes them inaccessible. Record actual results and status. Report deviations for evaluation; make corrections only after the method and approval have been established.

Practice scenario: A utility joint is about to be covered before the required inspection.
Response: Delay covering it and request the inspection required by the quality plan.
